text: The worker converts bare CR to LF in-place, leaves CRLF unchanged and reads one extra byte when CR is the last byte of a chunk. A CR at EOF becomes LF; a following LF in the next chunk preserves the CR. The current boundary test constructs both cases and checks length and boundary bytes. This is a byte conversion operation, not a MIME or mbox-message parse; no repair run was executed. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Mbox repair preserves CRLF across the one-MiB read boundary
